title: WebSec Relation Edge (research memory graph)
description: One typed edge of the campaign's research memory graph. Deterministic kinds must carry a support anchor the audit can re-derive from; human-gated kinds must carry the attesting actor; 'resembles' is a derived query and must never appear here.

support.description: The anchor the edge is derived from (chain_id / evidence_id / pin / memory_id / commit). Required for deterministic kinds; the audit re-runs the derivation against it.

actor.description: null for deterministic edges minted by the harness; a recorded human identity for human-gated kinds (caused_by).
